classifications.reasoning: Rule detects a known Sendmail exploit (CVE-1999-0204) via a specific payload pattern, indicating an exploit attempt against a public-facing SMTP server.
Rule matches a buffer overflow attempt in Netmanager Chameleon SMTPd via an overly long HELP command, which is an exploit against a public-facing mail service.
Rule detects a malformed MIME charset parameter used to trigger a denial-of-service in Exchange 5.5, an application-layer exhaustion attack.
Rule looks for the EXPN decode command, a known Sendmail vulnerability (CVE-1999-0096) that allows remote command execution, constituting an exploit of a public-facing application.
Rule detects EXPN root, which is used to enumerate the root mailing alias for reconnaissance of user accounts on the mail server.
Rule matches a Majordomo command-injection exploit (CVE-1999-0207) via a crafted Reply-To header, targeting a public-facing mailing list manager.
Rule detects a Sendmail 5.5.5 exploit (CVE-1999-0203) using a pipe character in the MAIL FROM command to execute arbitrary commands.
Rule identifies RCPT TO commands containing shell metacharacters (pipe or semicolon), a classic Sendmail command-injection exploit attempt.
Rule targets RCPT TO decode attempts, another variant of the Sendmail decode alias exploit (CVE-1999-0203) for remote code execution.
Rule matches a Sendmail 5.6.5 exploit that pipes the MAIL FROM address to the tail command, achieving command execution on the mail server.
Rule detects a Sendmail 8.6.10 exploit pattern (CVE-1999-0204) using a crafted configuration line to run programs.
Rule detects a variant of the Sendmail 8.6.10 exploit with tab characters, same CVE-1999-0204, for remote code execution.
Rule matches a Sendmail 8.6.9 exploit pattern (CVE-1999-0204) that injects a configuration line to execute arbitrary commands.
Rule detects another Sendmail 8.6.9 exploit variant (CVE-1999-0204) using a crafted daemon configuration line for command execution.
Rule matches a Sendmail 8.6.9c exploit (CVE-1999-0204) with a carriage-return line-feed sequence to inject a malicious configuration.
Rule looks for VRFY decode, a Sendmail vulnerability (CVE-1999-0096) that can lead to remote command execution via the decode alias.
